verdicts.reason: Both banners break the original into scattered fragments, and both shrink the RSVP CTA to the size of the FREE ENTRY/ALL AGES/TASTINGS pills, so the call to action is buried. A: the broken missing-asset placeholder sits under the logo; the italic subhead comes before the headline and 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' sits after it at far right, so the reading order is reversed; the legal copy is almost as large as the URL. B is worse: the missing-asset placeholder overlaps 'Saturday 21 June' (an unintended collision), the headline is smaller and less dominant, the subhead drops below the pill row, and the time line is pushed into a cramped right column with the legal text.
